name: form-consistency
description: Form-level checks across all entries: do answers contradict each other (dates out of order, age vs birth date, city/state/ZIP mismatch, totals vs itemized), and is the submission genuine rather than a test, joke, or spam. Layer 3 of laya_mcp/forms.py.
serving: Used by laya_mcp.forms.validate_form. A contradiction_p at or above LAYA_FORM_CONTRADICTION_P (default 0.6) sends the form to review. LAYA_FORM_GENUINE_MIN_P is off (0) for the base checkpoint, which scored a clean form at 0.12; with this tuned checkpoint set it to 0.3 (measured: every test fake rejected, no genuine form rejected) so test, joke and spam submissions are rejected. Note `genuine` is positive-polarity (true = good), so it is not part of the flag aggregate.
